prompt:
A portrait 390×844 mobile web app screen for「台灣停車預測」at edge to edge, with no browser or device frame. The visitor is driving toward「新莊體育館」and needs a clear way to compare nearby roadside spaces with a public parking lot. Render the complete first screen: product name and bottom navigation, destination search, location and filter buttons, a large usable street map with labeled roads, a selected space detail sheet, and a short nearby index.
Lead with the logic of a pocket city atlas. On the close map, give each curbside space on one short block an individual number; the same number starts its comparison row below. Keep the road block open enough for touch selection and leave farther streets uncluttered. Show the destination, a distinct off-street garage, and available, occupied, and unknown space examples with shape, label and color. Select「正中路 25 號」and state「目前觀測：有位」「距離 180 公尺」「資料品質：可用」「一般汽車適用性：已確認」「官方觀測時間：未提供」「系統取得：10:28」「收費：20 元／小時」「抵達預測：資料不足」. Label everything「合成示意資料，非即時資訊」without naming any government source.
Use a warm ivory atlas ground, deep green route lettering, muted road lines, small coral and ochre index marks, and disciplined blue-gray type. Map, search and everyday controls remain recognizably those of a real parking app; the atlas is one restrained graphic signature. Make the screen readable at phone size. No real route, ETA, availability probability, model advantage, factual source claim, printed-page fold, or poster treatment.
